ports_metadata.scope: Country catalog atlas-work/geo/countries.json, plus Svalbard (SJ). Entire transcontinental countries included. Egypt is retained as explicitly included in the shared atlas catalog.
ports_metadata.null_policy: Unknown/blank flags become null. Non-positive dimension/depth values become null for usable measurements; original CSV strings including 0.0 remain in raw_attributes. This is a conservative display/filter rule, not a claim that NGA explicitly defines every zero as missing.
ports_metadata.depth_policy: Modern WPI reports numeric metres, not legacy letter ranges. Do not manufacture ranges or derive allowed draft from depth.
ports_metadata.current_operation_policy: No WPI record has current-operation verification. Only separately dated evidence supports activity claims.
ports_metadata.storage_policy: Static tonnes, cubic metres and square metres remain separate; annual throughput never becomes storage capacity.
ports_metadata.connection_policy: Communications - Rail covers port and/or nearby area; Railway is ship repair; no WPI road-connection field.
